data.one_liner: Integrates Microsoft Clarity Analytics into Flutter Web applications for session recording.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter Web applications to integrate Microsoft Clarity Analytics. It includes a canvas capture workaround to visualize Flutter canvas content in recordings and provides masking widgets to hide sensitive data.
use_when: You need to use Microsoft Clarity analytics and session recordings in a Flutter Web app.
You want to hide sensitive user data from session recordings using mask widgets.
avoid_when: Your application is targeted entirely at native mobile or desktop platforms without web support.
You prefer a different analytics platform like Sentry.
strengths: Provides an optimized canvas capture workaround for Flutter Web canvas elements.
Includes `ClarityMask` and `ClarityUnmask` widgets for privacy compliance.
Offers FPS and image quality controls.
weaknesses: Canvas capture relies on a workaround since direct Flutter Web canvas recording is not supported natively.
Mandatory configuration required (`setIsCanvasMirrorActive(true)`) for visual recordings to work.
data.setup_notes: Requires getting a Project ID from Microsoft Clarity and calling initialization methods in code.

alternatives.name: sentry
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want comprehensive error tracking and performance monitoring rather than visual session recordings.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an established Flutter-focused monitoring and error reporting tool.
